title: Podman container storage
whyItMatters: Containers keep their whole filesystem on disk, and named volumes hold database files and uploaded data. Removed containers do not always remove their volumes.
source: containers-storage.conf(5): the rootless graph root defaults to ~/.local/share/containers/storage: https://man.archlinux.org/man/containers-storage.conf.5
notes: volumes/ holds named volumes, overlay/ the container layers. Run as root, Podman uses /var/lib/containers/storage, which this rule does not cover. Docker with a rootless setup uses ~/.local/share/docker instead.
